name: gitignore_gen
description: Build a .gitignore from named stacks (Python, Node, Go, Rust, Java, Maven, Gradle, C, C++, Dotnet, VisualStudio, Swift, Ruby, Rails, Android, Unity, Terraform, Flutter, macOS, Windows, Linux, JetBrains, VisualStudioCode, Vim and more: 44 templates with common aliases), combined in the order given with a header per section and repeated patterns removed when that cannot change what is ignored. The templates are bundled from github/gitignore (CC0-1.0) at a pinned commit, recorded in the output.

dedupe.description: Drop patterns already present in an earlier section

extra.description: Your own patterns, appended in a Custom section

catalog.source: github/gitignore (CC0-1.0), commit 0e5d690153ca3da8a4a1aef2d053406f408f531c of 2026-10-02, bundled by tools/catalog/data/gitignore_gen.py; pattern semantics from git's gitignore(5)
